business_summary: Century Ginwa Retail Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the operation of department stores, a shopping mall, and supermarkets in the People's Republic of China. The company also engages in the properties management activities. Century Ginwa Retail Holdings Limited was incorporated in 2000 and is headquartered in Causeway Bay, Hong Kong.
business_summary_ko: Century Ginwa Retail Holdings Limited는 투자 지주 회사로 중화인민공화국에서 백화점, 쇼핑몰, 슈퍼마켓을 운영하고 있습니다. 회사는 또한 자산 관리 활동에도 참여합니다. Century Ginwa Retail Holdings Limited는 2000년에 설립되었으며 홍콩 코즈웨이 베이에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
